import json
from pathlib import Path
import vllm
root = Path(vllm.__file__).parent
rows = []
for path in [root / "envs.py", *root.glob("model_executor/layers/fla/ops/*.py"), *root.glob("model_executor/layers/mamba/gdn/*.py"), *root.glob("model_executor/models/qwen3_5*.py"), *root.glob("model_executor/layers/quantization/__init__.py")]:
    text = path.read_text()
    for n, line in enumerate(text.splitlines()):
        if any(s in line.lower() for s in ["gdn", "gated_delta", "fp4", "prefill_backend"]):
            rows.append({"file": str(path.relative_to(root)), "line": n+1, "text": line})
out = Path("/opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/results/setup/gdn-options.json")
out.write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(rows))
PY
